visual.description: Full-width dark section with centered text (headline, subheadline, body, 2 CTA buttons) above a centered product image on black background.
Full-width light blue section with centered text above a centered angled product image, transitioning from dark hero above.
Full-width dark section with centered headline, subheadline, date text, and 2 CTA buttons stacked above product image area.
Two equal-width columns side by side, each containing centered product name, tagline, date text, 2 CTAs, and a product image below.
Two equal columns: left is light blue with iPad Air and CTAs, right is dark with AirPods lifestyle photo and CTAs.
Two equal columns: left dark with iPhone 17 Pro text and CTAs, right light with Apple Trade In promo text and offer details.
Two equal image panels side by side: left is dark with orange iPhone, right is light with iPhone accessories in hand.
Full-width light section with a single large centered headline 'Endless entertainment.' above a horizontal media carousel.
Horizontal scrolling carousel of media tiles (Apple TV show thumbnails) with a single featured large center tile and partially visible tiles on either side.
Three equal-width cards showing Apple Music, Apple Fitness+, and Apple Arcade with background images, logos, content titles, and action buttons.
Centered pagination dots row with 7 dots (first dot larger/active) and a right-arrow navigation control.
Full-width light section with two small-text legal paragraphs, left-aligned, followed by a horizontal divider.

Five equal-width columns of footer navigation links grouped under headings: Shop and Learn, Account, Apple Store, For Business, Apple Values — plus a second row with Apple Wallet and Entertainment columns.
Full-width footer bottom bar with copyright left-aligned and a region selector (United States) right-aligned, separated by a top border.
